prescreenRequired.note: Everyone majoring in Dance submits a pre-screening video; select applicants invited to a live audition. Reconfirmed Aug 2026: "Select applicants will be invited to a live audition session (which are offered in person and virtually)."

value.text: Introduction video, 60 seconds or less: name, where you're from, experience, why Chapman.
Dance solo, 2 minutes: wide range of technique/artistry; no zooming, close-ups, or editing.
Optional: if skilled in more than one form (jazz/modern/ballet/tap), present two shorter pieces.
Resume: training, teachers, performance/technical experience, directors/choreographers, media work.
Letter of recommendation (creative abilities) — not required but highly encouraged.
